| Feature | Assembler | Compiler | Interpreter |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Input** | Assembly language code | High-level language code | High-level language code |
| **Output** | Machine language code (Object code) | Machine language code (Object code) | Direct execution (no intermediate object file) |
| **Execution Speed** | Fast execution after assembly | Very fast execution speed | Slower execution speed (translates line-by-line during runtime) |
| **Error Handling** | Reports errors after checking the entire file | Reports all syntax errors together after scanning the whole code | Reports errors line-by-line and stops at the first error |
| **Examples** | NASM, TASM | GCC, Clang | Python interpreter, JavaScript engine |
proTip: Remember that compilers translate the entire program at once, whereas interpreters translate and execute line-by-line.
